body:
After studying pharma fennica for effects I desided to take 1mg of Temazepam I found at my workplace.
After the first hour I started feel very relaxed, I was completely happy with whatever I was doing. This was quite expected for temazepam is an anti-anxiety drug. I didn't have any anxiety on doing anything. and everything I was doing felt eazy and.... satisfying. I was still completely capable on logic thinking and actually found it a bit easier to engage in conversations.
After watching tv for about half an hour me and few friends left to night club.
Same feeling still. Just sitting still. Everything seemed to happen a bit slower and I was a bit bothered by the music.
I was not feeling euphoria but very relaxed and somewhat satisfied.
Nightclubs are very dull and boring places when on temazepam. I
prefer to stay in whit friends and watch cartoons.
